LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_cut: They will dress the loose rock near their camp into blocks, chunk by chunk, and stack the blocks at their camp.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_shear: They shear flocks for a living: taken on, they shear the colony's beasts in its pens by day, for one fleece in ten.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Facts_catch: They will rope one or two of the wild herd near their camp, keep them by their picket and lead them away when they go.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Caught: {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} has roped a {THING} out of the wild herd, and it is theirs now, kept by their picket.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_StoneGoing: One of them is already bringing a load of their stone over.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoStone: They haven't dressed enough stone yet to sell a load.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoChunks: There's no loose rock left outside the home area for them to work.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_Shearing: They're already at work in the colony's pens.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoFleece: The colony's flock has too little wool on it to be worth their blades.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_NoCaught: They haven't caught a beast they could sell.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_StoneSold: {X_nameDef} set down {COUNT} {THING} from the stonecutters' work by the colony's gate, and {SILVER} silver for it is going over to their camp.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_StoneSoldShort: {X_nameDef} set down {COUNT} {THING} by the colony's gate. It came to {PRICE} silver, but the colony had only {SILVER} left to send over, and the {NAME} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_CampLand_StoneSoldUnpaid: {X_nameDef} set down {COUNT} {THING} by the colony's gate, but the colony had no silver left for the {PRICE} it came to, and the {NAME} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_Impact_StoneSale: One of the {0} carries a load of their dressed stone to the colony's gate, and the colony pays for it there
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ClearNear_cut: The {0} work the loose rock nearest the colony first, outside its home area; the stone stays theirs
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShearFlock: The {0} shear the colony's beasts in its pens by day ({1} with wool ready now), and leave the wool for its haulers
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ShearShare: One fleece in ten goes in their packs
LanguageData.CC_Impact_ChildrenLesson: {0} go over to the {1}'s camp for a lesson ({2} practice)
